<reason>A won by making the motion’s actual tradeoff—accepting slower arrival—the decision rule and showing that wait is unsorted, uncapped, and unnecessary given co-response/crisis-trained alternatives. B’s “who comes through the door” and non-caller frames stayed live but were weaker than A’s real-caller weighing and the dispatch trap. Competitive: B’s equity/silence argument never fully died, and A’s second rebuttal was clipped.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s post-pressure turn: B’s rule to withhold the fast responder for “suicidal talk without a weapon,” plus no minute cap, converted B’s own sorting answer into a reason to reject the motion as written.</best_rebuttal>
